# OpenCC single-character dictionary snapshot

Upstream: https://github.com/BYVoid/OpenCC

STCharacters.txt and LICENSE are unmodified upstream files at commit
178f05dbc5dbcedd09d4ab39d501094f4d9d8820. Original header and Apache-2.0
license are retained. Exact URLs, byte lengths, and SHA-256 hashes appear in
PROVENANCE.json. This README and the provenance record were added by VERSEFORGE.

VERSEFORGE uses all listed character candidates, not OpenCC phrase conversion,
preferred-form selection, or a claim that OpenCC supplies historical readings.
Historical tone and rhyme memberships remain separately attributed to the rhyme
tables. No OpenCC Python package, binary, or network request is needed at runtime.
